HFT visibility is governed by the authoring policy above.","docket_mode":"blocked","docket_ready":false}},"selected_context_units":[],"support_registry":[{"branch_refs":["root_000064/B001","root_000064/B003","root_001283/B001","root_001283/B003"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-4","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_0e5083c8507c197ac7bf","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"98:6:5\",\"root_000064\",[\"B001\",\"B003\"]],[\"98:6:6\",\"root_001283\",[\"B001\",\"B003\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Kitap ehli adı kalıcı bir üstünlük sağlamaz; metne bağlılığın değeri, bağlayıcı yazıya verilen karşılıkla gösterilmek zorundadır.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000429/B001","root_000429/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-2","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_17cf160d522220f293ed","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"98:6:11\",\"root_000429\",[\"B001\",\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Sürekli kalış, yalnızca sonsuz süre değil, kanıttan sonra sürdürülen reddin kendi sonucuna sabit bir bağlanışa dönüşmesidir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000429/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_3055db17cee409b86953","text":"2. **Persistence hardening into attachment to a consequence.** **Lexical evidence:** `خَٰلِدِينَ` anchors `خ ل د` B001, “enduring permanence,” and activates B002, “leaning, clinging, and staying close.” **Structural cue and role:** 98:1 described a state that did not cease until proof arrived; 98:4 showed the post-proof choice, and the present ayah turns that persistence into settled residence. The clinging branch gives duration a relational role: the actors remain attached to the environment matching their response. **Abductive move:** I infer continuity between maintained rejection and maintained consequence; the packet does not state a psychological habit becoming a place. **Reading change:** `خَٰلِدِينَ` means more than endless clock time: it is a state of fixed adhesion after a disclosure that had opened the possibility of release.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001307/B001","root_001307/B003","root_001564/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_3cf67b07b3642d3b2784","text":"1. **Fire as the reversal of concealment through exposure.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `كَفَرُوا` anchors `ك ف ر` B001, “covering and concealment,” and B003, rejection of truth; fixed `نَار` anchors `ن و ر` B002, “burning fire,” while B001 supplies “light and illumination.” **Structural cue and role:** the group has already encountered `ٱلْبَيِّنَة`, purified sheets, and upright writings; the outcome then places covering beside a root that unites flame and illumination. Fire supplies both consequence and involuntary visibility. **Abductive move:** I infer that judgment exposes the stance that tried to cover disclosure; the packet gives the lexical opposition, not the purpose of the fire. **Reading change:** `نَار` is not only destructive heat but a revelatory reversal in which concealment can no longer remain concealed.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000787/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:5","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_406d5323c64a1156081e","text":"5. **Exploratory: evil as harm that throws off sparks.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `شَرّ` securely takes `ش ر ر` B001, but the nearby fire activates dormant B003, “flying sparks of fire.” **Structural cue and role:** `نَار` and `شَرّ` occur in the same short outcome clause, and the next two ayat replace fire with sound action and flowing rivers. The spark image gives “worstness” a propagative role: harmful response does not remain self-contained. **Abductive move:** I infer outward propagation from physical proximity alone; no morphology in `شَرّ` specifies sparks, so this is the weak link. **Reading change:** tentatively, the superlative can be heard as a judgment on generative harm, not only on static badness.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000064/B001","root_001283/B001","root_001283/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:4","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_6aa16bcb365e9d87c0a0","text":"4. **Inherited belonging overridden by demonstrated fitness.** **Lexical evidence:** `أَهْل` anchors `ء ه ل` B001, belonging, and activates B003, fitness or worthiness; `ٱلْكِتَٰب` anchors `ك ت ب` B001 and B003, joined writing and binding prescription. **Structural cue and role:** the affiliation from 98:1 and 98:4 is repeated inside the adverse outcome, while 98:7 shifts the criterion to faith and sound acts. B001 names the inherited or corporate bond; B003 becomes the expectation corrected by the outcome. **Abductive move:** I infer that worthiness must be demonstrated by response to the joined prescription. **Reading change:** the phrase no longer functions as a stable rank: textual membership is subordinated to what one does with the text.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000099/B001","root_000100/B001","root_000787/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_89008e15f5229c2d9e26","text":"3. **A ranking produced within one created field.** **Lexical evidence:** `شَرّ` anchors `ش ر ر` B001, “evil and badness”; `ٱلْبَرِيَّة` anchors the shared-ID `ب ر ء` B001, “creation and bringing into being.” **Structural cue and role:** 98:7 repeats `ٱلْبَرِيَّة` unchanged but replaces `شَرّ` with `خَيْر`, after pairing faith with intentional sound action. Creation is the common denominator; response supplies the differentiating value. **Abductive move:** I infer that the paired clauses rank enacted orientation rather than two different origins. **Reading change:** “worst of creation” is not an ontological claim about a separately made kind; it is a post-disclosure appraisal inside a shared status as creatures.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001307/B001","root_001307/B003","root_001564/B001","root_001564/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-1","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_8ba7cf2ae8e852de35c1","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"98:6:3\",\"root_001307\",[\"B001\",\"B003\"]],[\"98:6:9\",\"root_001564\",[\"B001\",\"B002\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Ateş, gerçeği örtmeye çalışan tutumu hem yakarak hem aydınlatarak istem dışı biçimde açığa çıkaran bir tersine dönüş olur.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000787/B003","root_001564/B002"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-5","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_b12e04b9c4df40322995","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"98:6:9\",\"root_001564\",[\"B002\"]],[\"98:6:15\",\"root_000787\",[\"B003\"]]],\"grade\":\"reject\",\"text\":\"Kötülüğün kıvılcım boyutu, ateşle yan yana gelişinde zararın kendi içinde kalmayıp çevreye yayıldığını düşündürür.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000099/B001","root_000100/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_b9c1baffea5dec2b2112","text":"3. **Worst of creation as failed createdness/clearance.** Evidence: ب ر ء B001 creation/bringing into being, B002 clearance/separation, B004 releasing a claim; خ ي ر in 98:7 B001 opposite good. Structural cue: 98:7 immediately reverses شرّ البرية with خير البرية. Assigned role: البرية frames both groups as creatures made by God, while شر marks a deformation of created purpose. Abductive move: I infer that “worst” is measured against the gift and accountability of being created, not against social identity alone. Reading change: the condemnation is ontological and legal: created beings who refuse clearance become the worst created beings.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000429/B001","root_000787/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_e23a75c5ecb0b9555067","text":"98:7’s exact repetition of `ٱلْبَرِيَّة` with the opposite appraisal corrected a possible ontological reading of `شَرّ`: shared creation remains constant while response changes rank. 98:8 then repeated `خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا` in a life-bearing environment, revealing that fixed `خ ل د` B001 is not itself the negative element; the object of attachment activates B002 and determines the value of permanence. Its flowing rivers also strengthen the fire/spark contrast behind the exploratory `ش ر ر` B003 reading, though the morphological link remains weak.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_eacfe219964106472526","text":"98:7’s exact reversal “خير البرية” prevented reading 98:6 as ethnic or textual labeling alone; it is a paired createdness verdict. 98:8’s خلدين فيها أبدا intensified the permanence mechanism already latent in “منفكين.”","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000429/B001","root_000429/B002","root_000791/B006"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_eae0207e369a976f4085","text":"2. **No release hardens into permanence.** Evidence: ف ك ك in 98:1 B003 non-cessation/no release; خ ل د B001 enduring permanence and B002 clinging/staying close; ش ر ك B006 snare. Structural cue: 98:1 says they are not منفكين until proof; 98:6 says خالدين فيها after rejecting it. Assigned role: khalūd names the final state of failed unfastening. Abductive move: I supply the temporal arrow that missed release can become fixed residence. Reading change: permanence here reads as the afterlife form of an earlier entanglement.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000787/B001","root_000787/B003","root_001307/B001","root_001307/B003","root_001564/B001","root_001564/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_fae2b499a2e42c808884","text":"1. **Covered truth becomes exposing fire.** Evidence: ك ف ر B001 covering and B003 rejection of truth; ن و ر B002 burning fire/branding and B001 illumination; ش ر ر B003 flying sparks and B001 evil.
